entities.name: Suzue
entities.description: Proud, stubborn female orochi from Kamigawa and mother of Seshiro; fatally wounded by a kami of decay.

entities.name: Seshiro
entities.description: Orochi son of Suzue who became Broodmaster.

entities.name: Dosan
entities.description: Monk of Okina Suzue met and spoke with about the kami's anger.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War whose causes Suzue left the Jukai to seek out.

entities.name: Okina
entities.description: Sanctuary Suzue reached and where Seshiro studied.

entities.name: Sosuke
entities.description: Child of Seshiro, leader of the Kashi tribe.

entities.name: Sachi
entities.description: Child of Seshiro, leader of the Sakura tribe.

events.summary: Suzue leaves the Jukai Forest, though pregnant, to learn the reasons behind the Kami War.
events.quote: Suzue left the Jukai Forest to seek out the reasons behind the Kami War

events.summary: Suzue meets the monk Dosan at Okina.
events.quote: where she met the monk Dosan

events.summary: A kami of decay attacks Suzue, Seshiro and Dosan; Suzue is fatally wounded.
events.quote: Seshiro saved Dosan, but Suzue was fatally wounded.

relations.quote: She was the mother of Seshiro
